name: print-social-holo-graphic-poster-white-black-bands-holographic-blob
title: 'Holo Graphic' poster with black text bands and a large holographic blob wrapping two corners
whatItMeans: Bold and current; the wraparound holographic shape gives a stark black-and-white layout an on-trend, futuristic edge.
whatItIs: A white square post with a black band across the top curved by a holographic wave, bold black 'HOLO GRAPHIC' title, a black band of body copy at bottom, and a large glossy holographic blob wrapping from bottom-right up through the centre.
techniques: Curve a solid colour band with a holographic wave edge.
Let one large holographic shape span from corner to corner.
Contrast the shiny holographic area against flat black-and-white blocks.

vocabulary.definition: A curved, flowing line used to break up a straight band.
A large graphic element spanning diagonally across a layout.
